# kempo-ui LLM Reference

Lit-based web component library. All custom elements are prefixed `k-`. Components use kempo-css for styling, which is automatically injected into every shadow root.

---

## Install

```bash
npm install kempo-ui
```

## Page Setup

Configure `window.kempo` before importing components. All properties are optional:

```html
<script>
  window.kempo = {
    pathToStylesheet: '/assets/kempo.min.css',
    pathsToIcons: ['/icons'],
    overlayRoot: '#app'
  };
</script>
```

`pathToStylesheet` defaults to `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/kempo-css@2/dist/kempo.min.css` if unset. Set it to a local copy of kempo-css to serve the stylesheet yourself.
`pathsToIcons` defaults to `['./icons', '/icons', '../icons', '../../icons']` if unset; these are local paths searched in order when resolving `<k-icon name="...">`.
`overlayRoot` is a CSS selector for the element that fixed-position overlay content should be appended into instead of `document.body` (e.g. to keep it out of a fixed header, or a custom titlebar in an Electron app). Shared by Toast, Dialog, and PhotoViewer. Resolved lazily on first use, so it can be set at any point. Falls back to `document.body` if unset or the selector matches nothing.

---

## Importing Components

Each component file self-registers on import. Import individual files:

```html
<script type="module" src="node_modules/kempo-ui/src/components/Toggle.js"></script>
```

```js
import 'kempo-ui/src/components/Toggle.js';
```

Lit templates are available from `src/lit-all.min.js`:

```js
import { html, css, LitElement } from 'kempo-ui/src/lit-all.min.js';
```

---

## Components

| Element(s) | File | Description | Docs |
|-----------|------|-------------|------|
| `<k-accordion>` `<k-accordion-header>` `<k-accordion-panel>` | `Accordion.js` | Collapsible panel groups; `for-panel` attribute links headers to panels | [accordion.html](https://dustinpoissant.github.io/kempo-ui/components/accordion.html) |
| `<k-aside>` `<k-aside-item>` `<k-aside-label>` `<k-aside-menu>` `<k-aside-spacer>` `<k-aside-toggle>` | `Aside.js` | Sidebar/drawer; `main="push"` or `main="overlay"`, `mobile-main="overlay"` (or `push`) used at or below 768px, `push-from-offscreen="collapsed"` / `overlay-from-collapsed="offscreen"` (optional state changes on layout change), `side="left|right"`; `<k-aside-item group="Name">` auto-wraps items sharing a group (2+, `group-min`) in a menu, icon from `group-icons` JSON / `group-icon` / folder | [aside.html](https://dustinpoissant.github.io/kempo-ui/components/aside.html) |
| `<k-aside-btn>` | `AsideBtn.js` | Small floating button (FAB, extends Button, default menu icon, slot replaces it) in a corner (`position="top left"` default, or `top right`, `bottom left`, `bottom right`) that toggles the aside named by `for="id"`; hidden under an open aside by default, `push` keeps it visible and moves it beside the aside; dimmed to 70% opacity until hovered; show or hide by breakpoint with kempo-css classes (`class="d-n m-d-b"`); style with classes | [aside-btn.html](https://dustinpoissant.github.io/kempo-ui/components/aside-btn.html) |
| `<k-calendar>` | `Calendar.js` | Inline month-grid date picker widget; `mode="single"` (default) or `mode="range"`; `value` is ISO `YYYY-MM-DD` (single) or comma-separated pair (range); `min`/`max` bounds; `readonly` (Boolean: shows the date and submits it, days cannot be picked, month and year still navigable); form-associated; fires `change` | [calendar.html](https://dustinpoissant.github.io/kempo-ui/components/calendar.html) |
| `<k-card>` | `Card.js` | Bordered container; optional `label` attribute | [card.html](https://dustinpoissant.github.io/kempo-ui/components/card.html) |
| `<k-card-grid>` | `CardGrid.js` | Generic version of `<k-table>` for grids of `<k-card>` tiles instead of rows — matches Table's selection/pagination/CRUD API (`getSelectedRecords`, `selectAllOnPage`, `deselectAllOnPage`, `selectionChange`, etc.) and sets `controlled` on itself, so `kc-tc-*` controls work in its `slot="top"` unmodified; no columns, so no sorting/filtering/search/inline-editing; `cardTemplate(record, host)` renders each tile | [card-grid.html](https://dustinpoissant.github.io/kempo-ui/components/card-grid.html) |
| `<k-chat-bubble>` | `ChatBubble.js` | Round floating chat button (FAB, `--c_primary`) for customer service or any LLM you connect (its `prompt-api` option uses the browser's built-in AI, which is VERY EXPERIMENTAL and not useful yet) fixed to a corner (`position="bottom right"` default, `bottom left`, `top left`, `top right`); click opens a popup `<k-chat>` above (below at the top) and the icon becomes a down chevron, click again (or Escape) minimizes; works for a person or the AI: it slots `controls-top` (the header bar, before the built-in list and + icons; buttons/links are styled for you), `controls-side` (small slot above Send, e.g. a `tel:` call button) and `controls-bottom` (row at the very bottom), the last two passed to the chat; the collapse chevron points up when at the top; forwards `empty-message`, `input` (default `markdown`: a clean textarea; `markdown-editor` adds a compact toolbar), `prompt-api`, `prompt-tools` (property `promptTools`), `persistent-id`, `placeholder`, `show-status`, `enter-newline`, `disabled` to the inner chat, which is `bubble.chat` (`await bubble.updateComplete` first); with `persistent-id` the open/closed state is kept for the tab (sessionStorage) so an open chat survives page navigation, and the first open lists saved conversations (continue / delete after a `Dialog.confirm` / new); an incoming message or finished AI reply while minimized sets `unread` (icon `mark_chat_unread`, wiggle + pulse between primary and danger; cleared on open; set it yourself for server pushes); `heading` (optional; the header bar is hidden without a heading, `controls-top` content or `persistent-id`); `allow-fullscreen` adds a full screen icon to the header (the popup then fills the window one `--spacer` from the edges, clear of the round button; `fullscreen` reflects it, Escape leaves it first, kept with `persistent-id`), method `toggleFullscreen()`, event `fullscreen-change`; methods `show()`, `hide()`, `toggle()`, `showConversations()`; fires `open`, `close` and re-fires the chat's `send`, `response`, `error`, `tool-call`, `message-add`, `conversation-change`, `conversation-save`; `--chat_bubble_size/offset/width/height` | [chat-bubble.html](https://dustinpoissant.github.io/kempo-ui/components/chat-bubble.html) |
| `<k-chat>` | `Chat.js` | Chat-room widget (its `prompt-api`, `promptTools` and `debug` features use the browser's built-in AI, which is VERY EXPERIMENTAL and not useful yet: it could not answer a single question correctly in testing); `empty-message` text centered in the message area while there are no messages (not `placeholder`, which is the input's placeholder); `input` picks what the user types in: `markdown` (default, plain auto-growing box whose text is markdown), `markdown-editor` (embedded `<k-markdown-editor>` with tabs and toolbar; `markdown-resize` adds its drag handle), `resize` (handle under the whole chat, the message window grows; no handle by default), `html-editor` (`<k-html-editor>`), `markdown` (plain auto-growing textarea whose text is markdown) or `text` (plain textarea sent escaped); the editors are lazy-loaded only when chosen, `await chat.updateComplete` waits for them; `focus()` focuses the input; slots `controls-top` (row above the input; the toolbar in `markdown-editor`), `controls-side` (beside the input, above Send; `markdown`/`text` only) and `controls-bottom` (row below the input; beside Send in the editors), each takes no room while empty; `send(text?)` sends that text instead of the input; with `html-editor` the `send` `markdown` is the plain text; markdown input via embedded `<k-markdown-editor>` (rendered through `marked` with `breaks:true` so single newlines become `<br>`, then run through `sanitizeHtml` so any inline HTML is filtered against the allow-list); default Enter sends / Shift+Enter newline (Slack-style), add `enter-newline` to invert; `show-status` (or `show-status="text"` / `show-status="icons"`) renders iMessage-style `sending`/`delivered`/`read`/`failed` only on the most recent outgoing message (sending/failed always show); methods `addMessage(msg)`, `updateMessage(id, updates)`, `removeMessage(id)`, `clear()`, `send()`; `prompt-api="/path/to/system-prompt.md"` makes it a chat with the browser's built-in language model (via `promptApi.js`; several space-separated URLs are read in order and joined; empty value = no system prompt; the `promptTools` property takes `[{ name, description, inputSchema, execute(args) }]` the model can call, e.g. to change the page theme, and fires `tool-call` with `{name, arguments, result}`; the reply streams in as an incoming message, `clear()` also resets the model's memory); `persistent-id="name"` saves the messages in IndexedDB (via `conversations.js`; the name is a group) and restores the newest conversation of the group after a reload, giving the model the saved turns as its history; methods `newConversation()`, `loadConversation(id)`, `listConversations()`, `deleteConversation(id)` (`clear()` also deletes the saved one); messages also carry `markdown` and `transient` (never saved); fires `conversation-change` `{id}` and `conversation-save` `{id}`; with `prompt-api`, `debug` records each step of the model conversation (system prompt, what was sent, raw replies, tool calls and results, context used) with the saved conversation, `debug="console"` also prints it, `chat.debugLog` / `exportConversation(id?)` give it as text (with the messages) and `renameConversation(id, title)` sets a title that sticks; fires `message-add` with `{message}` for every added message, `send` with `{id, html, markdown}`, and with `prompt-api` also `response` with `{id, html, markdown}` and `error` with `{error}` | [chat.html](https://dustinpoissant.github.io/kempo-ui/components/chat.html) |
| `<k-code-editor>` | `CodeEditor.js` | Monaco-powered code editor; `value`, `language`, `controls`, `disabled`/`readonly`/`required` attributes; form-associated (full validity + reset/restore/disabled callbacks); theme-aware; toolbar button controls use the unified `kc-*` prefix and extend `ButtonControl` from `controls/Button.js` | [code-editor.html](https://dustinpoissant.github.io/kempo-ui/components/code-editor.html) |
| `<k-color-picker>` | `ColorPicker.js` | Full color picker (hex, rgb, hsl, hsv, alpha); `disabled` (Boolean: no changes, left out of the form); `readonly` (Boolean: shows the color and submits it; text field read-only, format select and swatch disabled); `value` property | [color-picker.html](https://dustinpoissant.github.io/kempo-ui/components/color-picker.html) |
| `<k-combobox>` | `Combobox.js` | Searchable dropdown with debounced `search` event, dynamic `setOptions()`, `searching` indicator, keyboard nav; `readonly` (Boolean: shows the value and submits it; no typing, the list does not open); options are strings or `{label, value}` objects | [combobox.html](https://dustinpoissant.github.io/kempo-ui/components/combobox.html) |
| `<k-content-slider>` | `ContentSlider.js` | Swipeable carousel; `index`, `controls`, `loop`, `keyboard-controls`, `global-controls`, `min-height` (any CSS length, a minimum height for the slide area); the previous and next buttons are disabled on the first and last slide unless `loop` is on, and `previous()` / `next()` do nothing there (no events); its children are the slides, only the current one is in the page | [content-slider.html](https://dustinpoissant.github.io/kempo-ui/components/content-slider.html) |
| `<kc-nav-link>` | `controls/NavLink.js` | Link control for navigation bars (`k-nav`, `k-control-bar`): `href`, `target` (`_blank` adds `rel="noopener"`); default slot holds the icon, `menu-text` slot (falls back to `title`) is its label, shown only while in the "more" menu; 40px tall, needs no controlled host | [nav.html](https://dustinpoissant.github.io/kempo-ui/components/nav.html) |
| `<k-control-bar>` | `ControlBar.js` | Single-row responsive toolbar with `default` (left), `center` and `right` slots spaced with flexbox; never wraps — when the controls no longer fit, they are moved (by switching their `slot` to `overflow`) into a vertical-ellipsis "more" menu one at a time and moved back as the bar grows; `collapse-order` (default `"right center left"`, `left` = `default`) sets which slot is emptied first, always starting from its last control; the "more" menu is a `kc-menu`; menus (`kc-menu`, `kc-vid-menu`, `k-dropdown`), `kc-spacer` and anything with `no-collapse` are never moved; a `k-control-group` moves as one unit, or one control at a time with `split` (each by its own `priority`, or the group's; `no-collapse` stays; a control that moves leaves its group and is listed in the menu in its original order; a group with nothing left is hidden); `priority` on a control (number, default 0, bare = 1) moves it into the menu later than lower-priority ones (unlike `no-collapse`, high priorities still move once the bar is small enough); plain `<a>` and `<button>` children (a navbar, say) collapse too, shown as full-width rows in the menu, and the "more" menu works without a controlled host; `soft-min-width` on a control (`8rem`, `120px`, or bare px) keeps it at least that wide while others are moved into the menu, then lets it shrink below that when nothing is left to move (the Audio/Video seek bar uses `8rem`); sets `has-control-bar` on the closest `[controlled]` host so HtmlEditor, CodeEditor, MarkdownEditor and Pagination let the toolbar fill the width; slot it in Table `top`, HtmlEditor/CodeEditor `toolbar-top-left`, MarkdownEditor `controls-top`, Audio/Video/Pagination default slot | [control-bar.html](https://dustinpoissant.github.io/kempo-ui/components/control-bar.html) |
| `<k-control-group>` | `ControlGroup.js` | Groups toolbar controls visually; strips child borders/radius/margin and adds right-side separators via `::slotted(*)`; auto-hides when all children are hidden; `split` (on a `k-control-group` or `kc-menu`, inside a `k-control-bar`) lets its controls collapse into the "more" menu one at a time, and the bar sets `collapsed` on a split group with nothing left; used internally by CodeEditor, HtmlEditor, and other toolbar-based components | — |
| `<k-page-builder>` | `PageBuilder.js` | Controlled page editor: a `k-control-bar` of `kc-pb-*` controls, the widget tree, the page in an iframe (the site's stylesheets, widget modules loaded there) and the settings of the selected widget. `value` is the page JSON `{ attrs, slots: { default: [nodes] } }` (a node is `{ id, type, attrs, slots }`); every change fires `change` with `detail.value`, Ctrl+S or the save button fires `saverequest` (and nothing else: the site stores the page, shows the result and calls `markSaved(detail.value)`); `templates` (`[{ name, nodes }]`) is listed under Insert a template, which fires `template-save` and `template-remove` (the builder keeps no templates); `device` (`desktop`, `tablet`, `phone`); on a narrow builder (its own width at or below `mobile-width`, default 768) `mobile` is true and it shows one view at a time (`view`: `tree`, `page`, `settings`; `setView()`) switched by a group of three `kc-pb-view` controls, with the tree, settings and device controls hidden; `dirty`; `stylesheets` (addresses the frame uses besides the host page's, set before the builder is added); `markSaved(page)` counts a page as saved (the builder keeps track of unsaved changes, warns before the page is left and turns the save button green); methods `requestSave()`, `markSaved(page)`, `reset()`, `undo()`, `redo()`, `insert(name)`, `canAdd(name)`, `setDevice()`, `toggleTree()`, `toggleSettings()`. Widgets come from the static `PageBuilder.widgets` list; `PageBuilder.addWidget({ name, title, category, tag, page, editor, editorTag, settings, settingsTag, attributes, slots, children, content, section, display, hideStyles, classes, style, render })` adds one (or replaces it by name), and its page, editor and settings are module paths. Ships these default widgets (text, markdown, image, video, audio, file, photo-viewer, media-gallery, hero, embed, group, breakout, container, columns, spacer, divider, button, table, html, script, accordion, tabs, card, content-slider, show-more, icon). Undo/redo keeps 50 steps in memory. Extra controls: an element with `slot="left-end"` (after the left controls), `slot="center-start"` / `slot="center-end"` (either side of the centre controls) or `slot="right-start"` (before the right controls) is placed in that spot of the bar and collapses into the "more" menu with its spot: a spot is one group, ranked by the highest `priority` among its controls (a bare `priority` is 1, none is 0 like the builder's own unranked controls, a negative one moves before them), so use `kc-*` controls (`ButtonControl` subclasses) to look like the rest of the bar. Page settings: a `slot="page-settings"` child is shown in the right panel under the title and description while nothing is selected. Dialogs (code editor, text editor, Add list, templates) are opened on the page, above a site's side navigation. Pickers: `PageBuilderFields.pickers.image`, `.video`, `.audio` and `.icon` are the pickers for those fields, a URL box or the icon selector by default, and a site replaces one with its own function of `{ id, value, change }` (see the picker pages under page-builder/) | [page-builder.html](https://dustinpoissant.github.io/kempo-ui/components/page-builder.html) |
| `<k-page-renderer>` | `PageRenderer.js` | Renders the page JSON from `k-page-builder` as a page: set `value`, and the element writes the widgets' HTML into itself, loads the modules they need and runs their scripts; fires `render` with `detail.value`. Plain HTML (no Lit). `PageRenderer.toHTML(value)` gives the HTML as a string. On a server, use `utils/renderPage.js` and `utils/pageWidgets.js` instead (the element defines custom elements, which a server cannot do); text is not sanitized by `toHTML`, so sanitize it on the server | [page-renderer.html](https://dustinpoissant.github.io/kempo-ui/components/page-renderer.html) |
| `<k-context>` | `Context.js` | Non-rendering state container; `set(key,value)`, `get(key)`, `delete(key)`, `clear()`, `getData()`; fires `context:create`, `context:set`, `context:delete` | [context.html](https://dustinpoissant.github.io/kempo-ui/components/context.html) |
| `<k-dialog>` | `Dialog.js` | Modal dialog with focus trapping; call `.open()` / `.close()` | [dialog.html](https://dustinpoissant.github.io/kempo-ui/components/dialog.html) |
| `<k-dropdown>` | `Dropdown.js` | Action menu with keyboard navigation | [dropdown.html](https://dustinpoissant.github.io/kempo-ui/components/dropdown.html) |
| `<k-filter-list>` `<k-filter-item>` | `FilterList.js` `FilterItem.js` | Filter/search list; items have `filter` attribute with keywords | [filter-list.html](https://dustinpoissant.github.io/kempo-ui/components/filter-list.html) |
| `<k-focus-capture>` | `FocusCapture.js` | Traps keyboard focus within children | [focus-capture.html](https://dustinpoissant.github.io/kempo-ui/components/focus-capture.html) |
| `<k-html-editor>` | `HtmlEditor.js` | WYSIWYG rich text editor; `value` property; `controls` attribute (`full`/`normal`/`minimal`/`none`) for built-in toolbars; `layout="floating"` hides the toolbars until the editor has focus and floats them above the content (below when there is no room); `disabled`/`readonly`/`required` (Lexical's `setEditable()` + Monaco's `readOnly`); form-associated; `nodes` loads custom Lexical nodes (a plain name from `htmlEditorNodes/`, or a URL starting with `/`, `.` or `http` including `.js`); `slot="toolbar-top-extra"` adds a control to the top toolbar without replacing the built-in ones | [html-editor.html](https://dustinpoissant.github.io/kempo-ui/components/html-editor.html) |
| `<k-markdown>` | `Markdown.js` | Renders child markdown text as sanitized HTML in place; `value` attribute (overrides children); `breaks` (single newline → `<br>`); `allowed-tags`/`disallowed-tags`/`scripts-enabled` for sanitization; light DOM render; `renderedHtml` getter | [markdown.html](https://dustinpoissant.github.io/kempo-ui/components/markdown.html) |
| `<k-markdown-editor>` | `MarkdownEditor.js` | Markdown editor with Write/Preview tabs; raw markdown is the form value; rendered with vendored `marked` (full CommonMark + GFM — tables, task lists, fenced code, autolinks, inline HTML) via `renderMarkdown.js`; then sanitized via `sanitizeHtml` using either `allowed-tags` (comma-separated allowlist; pass `*` for everything) OR `disallowed-tags` (denylist) — mutually exclusive, allowlist wins if both set; defaults cover standard markdown output incl. img/hr/table family; `<script>` is always stripped unless `scripts-enabled` attribute is set; iframe/style/etc. are always stripped; `value`, `name`, `placeholder`, `disabled`/`readonly`/`required`, `mode` (`write`/`preview`), `allowed-tags`, `controls` (`'minimal'`/`'normal'`/`'full'`/`'none'` — pre-built toolbar; auto-imports the relevant control modules; user-slotted children override the preset); methods `focus()`, `blur()`, `clear()`, `setMode()`, `togglePreview()`, plus selection helpers `getSelection()`, `replaceSelection()`, `wrapSelection()`, `insertAtCursor()`, `insertLinePrefix()`; `controls-top`/`controls-bottom` slots for toolbar buttons; built-in controls under `controls/` with `kc-*` prefix (`kc-bold`, `kc-italic`, `kc-strikethrough` (`~~...~~`), `kc-format-block` w/ `tag` (heading picker — `h1`-`h6`), `kc-inline-code`, `kc-md-link`, `kc-md-image` w/ `popup` (opens a Dropdown by default — `popup="dialog"` to switch to modal Dialog — for URL + alt text), `kc-md-table` (small Dropdown with cols × rows inputs + Create button, inserts a GFM markdown table), `kc-menu` w/ `label` (toolbar button that opens a Dropdown of slotted child controls; `icon` slot customizes the trigger button content), `kc-md-speech-to-text` w/ `language`/`continuous` (wraps `<k-speech-to-text>`; final transcript is inserted at the cursor), `kc-bullet-list`, `kc-number-list`, `kc-quote`); extend `ButtonControl` from `controls/Button.js` for custom buttons; fires `input`, `change`, `mode-changed` | [markdown-editor.html](https://dustinpoissant.github.io/kempo-ui/components/markdown-editor.html) |
| `<k-audio>` | `Audio.js` | Sound player with no native controls, the sound-only sibling of `<k-video>`; `src`, `preload`, `autoplay`/`loop`/`muted`, `volume`, `playback-rate`, `crossorigin`, `persistent-id` (resumes the position in the session), `skip-duration`, `download-name`, `artist`/`track-title`/`album`/`year` (shown by `kc-media-metadata`), `playlist-loop` (loop the whole playlist; off by default, so playback stops at the end), `exclusive` (pauses every other playing media on the page when this one plays); `controls` (`minimal`/`normal`/`full`/`none`) or slotted controls; `top`/`bottom` slots around the default controls and a `visualizer` slot above the whole toolbar (for `kc-audio-visualizer`, not counted as slotted content, so a player with only a visualizer keeps its preset controls); `--controls-bg` sets the player background; methods `play()`, `pause()`, `togglePlayPause()`, `seek(t)`, `skip(s)`, `setVolume(v)`, `mute()`, `unmute()`, `toggleMute()`, `setPlaybackRate(r)`, `toggleLoop()`, `download()`, `tracks` (getter for the `k-audio-track` children), `selectTrack(i)`, `playTrack(i)`, `previousTrack()`, `nextTrack()`, `togglePlaylistLoop()`, `toggleShuffle()`, `reorderTracks(order)`, `shuffled` (read); read `currentTime`/`duration`/`paused`/`playing`/`ended`; events bubble from the element (`play`, `pause`, `timeupdate`, `ended`, `volumechange`, `loop-changed`, `metadata-changed`, `src-changed`, `track-changed`, `playlist-changed`, `playlist-loop-changed`, `playlist-shuffling`, `shuffle-changed`, ...) | [audio.html](https://dustinpoissant.github.io/kempo-ui/components/audio.html) |
| `<k-audio-track>` | `AudioTrack.js` | One playlist entry, a child of `<k-audio>`; `src`, `artist`, `track-title`, `album`, `year`, `download-name` attributes. Hidden; not rendered. | [audio.html](https://dustinpoissant.github.io/kempo-ui/components/audio.html) |
| `<kc-audio-playlist>` | `controls/AudioPlaylist.js` | Drag-to-reorder list of the `<k-audio>` tracks (uses `k-sortable`), current track highlighted, clicking a track plays it. Usually `slot="top"`. | [audio.html](https://dustinpoissant.github.io/kempo-ui/components/audio.html) |
| `<kc-audio-previous>` / `<kc-audio-next>` | `controls/AudioPrevious.js` / `controls/AudioNext.js` | Buttons that move to the previous or next track of an `<k-audio>` playlist. | [audio.html](https://dustinpoissant.github.io/kempo-ui/components/audio.html) |
| `<kc-audio-loop>` | `controls/AudioLoop.js` | Button that loops the whole playlist (`active` while on). | [audio.html](https://dustinpoissant.github.io/kempo-ui/components/audio.html) |
| `<kc-audio-shuffle>` | `controls/AudioShuffle.js` | Toggle that shuffles the playlist and restores the saved order when turned off (`active` while on). Moving a track by hand turns it off. | [audio.html](https://dustinpoissant.github.io/kempo-ui/components/audio.html) |
| `<kc-audio-visualizer>` | `controls/AudioVisualizer.js` | Canvas that draws the playing sound as a gradient, `type="bars"` (default, `bars` sets how many, 48 by default) or `type="wave"`. Goes in the `<k-audio>` `visualizer` slot, above the toolbar, so it works with a playlist in `top`; it is not 40px tall, `--visualizer_height` (8rem) sizes it and it fills extra height the player is given. `--visualizer_color` (primary by default) is the middle third of its width and `--visualizer_color_2` (secondary by default) the outer edges, with a gradient between. Reads the sound through the Web Audio API, which routes the player's sound through it: only for a same-origin (`window.origin`), `blob:` or `data:` file, or when the player has `crossorigin` set and the server sends CORS headers; otherwise the player plays as normal and the visualizer stays flat with an `unavailable` attribute. Draws a flat resting state while paused or ended, and under `prefers-reduced-motion`. Waits for a `<k-audio>` that is defined after it. The Page Builder Audio widget has a Visualizer setting (Off, Bars, Waveform). | [audio.html](https://dustinpoissant.github.io/kempo-ui/components/audio.html) |
| `<kc-media-play-pause>`, `<kc-media-time>`, `<kc-media-seek>`, `<kc-media-duration>`, `<kc-media-volume>`, `<kc-media-mute>`, `<kc-media-speed>`, `<kc-media-repeat>`, `<kc-media-skip-back>`, `<kc-media-skip-forward>`, `<kc-media-download>`, `<kc-media-metadata>`, `<kc-media-link>` | `controls/Media*.js` | Controls that work with both `<k-audio>` and `<k-video>`. `kc-media-repeat` repeats the current track (`loop`). `kc-media-metadata` shows artist, title, album and year as a line that scrolls when it does not fit (`scroll-mode="auto"`, or `"always"`), and stops while paused. `kc-media-link` shows the media URL. | [audio.html](https://dustinpoissant.github.io/kempo-ui/components/audio.html) |

| `<k-import>` | `Import.js` | Includes external HTML fragments; `src` attribute | [import.html](https://dustinpoissant.github.io/kempo-ui/components/import.html) |
| `<k-main>` | `Main.js` | Layout main; automatically adjusts margins when a `k-aside[main="push"]` opens; content is a centered column up to `--container_width`, and `full-width` removes that limit and the side padding (wrap the content that should stay centered in a kempo-css `.container`); the sides are clipped (`overflow-x: clip`, no scroll container) so a full-screen-wide element, such as the Page Builder Fullscreen breakout, does not scroll the page sideways | — |
| `<k-media-gallery>` `<k-media-gallery-item>` | `MediaGallery.js` | Product-style gallery of images, videos, audio and any media type you register: a large stage, a thumbnail strip, arrows, swipe and a fullscreen viewer when an image is clicked. ## Forms

Every component that holds a value the user enters is form-associated: `<k-calendar>`, `<k-code-editor>`, `<k-color-picker>`, `<k-combobox>`, `<k-dropzone>`, `<k-html-editor>`, `<k-icon-selector>`, `<k-image-crop>`, `<k-markdown-editor>`, `<k-rating>`, `<k-search-dropdown>`, `<k-segmented-control>`, `<k-slider>`, `<k-tags>`, `<k-theme-select>`, `<k-theme-switcher>`, `<k-time>`, `<k-toggle>`, `<k-voice-selector>`.

- `name` submits the value with the form. Several values (Dropzone's files) submit under the same name.
- `required` blocks submission until a value is set.
- `readonly` shows the value and keeps it in the form, but blocks every user change. Programmatic changes still work, as they do for `disabled`.
- `disabled` blocks changes and leaves the value out of the form. A disabled `<fieldset>` sets it too.
- A form reset restores the value the element had when it was added (Dropzone clears its files; the theme components restore the global theme).

## Base Classes

All in `src/components/`. Built on Lit.

### ShadowComponent ← LitElement

Standard shadow-DOM component. **kempo-css is automatically injected** into the shadow root alongside `static styles`. Use for fully encapsulated components.

- Override `render()` → returns a Lit `html` template
- Override `childrenUpdated()` → called when light-DOM children change (MutationObserver)
- `createRenderRoot()` returns an inner `div` (not the shadow root itself); `this.shadowRoot` is still the real shadow root

### HybridComponent ← ShadowComponent

Renders into both shadow DOM and light DOM. kempo-css present in shadow DOM; light DOM is targetable by external page CSS.

- Override `render()` → shadow DOM content (default returns `<slot name="lightRoot"></slot>`)
- Override `renderLightDom()` → light DOM content (rendered into `this.lightRoot` div after every update)

### LightComponent ← LitElement

No shadow root. Renders entirely to light DOM. No kempo-css injection; styles come from the page.

- Override `renderLightDom()` → returns a Lit `html` template
- Same `childrenUpdated()` hook as ShadowComponent

### Button ← ShadowComponent

Base class for custom elements that behave like buttons. The custom element itself IS the button — no inner `<button>` required.

- `disabled` attribute/property blocks clicks, sets `aria-disabled`, removes from tab order
- `role="button"` and `tabindex` set automatically in `connectedCallback`
- Keyboard accessible: `Enter` / `Space` trigger `click()`
- `Button.styles` provides kempo-css button appearance on `:host`; extend via `static styles = [Button.styles, css`...`]`
- Public event handlers `handleClick` / `handleKeyDown` are arrow class fields — override or reference directly
- **Not registered to a tag** — extend it and call `customElements.define()`

### Unified Control Architecture (`controls/`)

All toolbar controls for CodeEditor, HtmlEditor, MarkdownEditor, Pagination, and Table use the `kc-*` tag prefix and live in `src/components/controls/`. Three base classes:

#### Control ← ShadowComponent (`controls/Control.js`, tag `kc-control`)

Base for non-button controls (dropdowns, inputs, status displays).

- `static requires = ['methodName', ...]` — host must expose these methods; missing → `disabled=true`
- `static hostMode = 'write'` or `['write', 'code']` — control hides when host's `mode` doesn't match (only checked when `'mode' in host`)
- `static hostEvents = ['event-name', ...]` — host events that trigger `requestUpdate()`
- `get host()` — walks shadow boundaries via `getRootNode()` → `closest('[controlled]')` to find the host component
- `invokeHost(method, ...args)` — safe method call on host

#### ButtonControl ← Control (`controls/Button.js`, tag `kc-button`)

Base for button-style controls. The host element IS the button (no inner `<button>`).

- Sets `role="button"`, `tabindex`, `aria-disabled`
- `handleAction()` — override point; called on click / Enter / Space
- Default `render()` returns `<slot></slot>`
- The `controls` presets of the editors, `k-audio`, `k-video`, `k-pagination` and `k-table` are `k-control-bar`s, so they collapse into a "more" menu on narrow screens; the center section of a bar grows (a stretchy control such as `kc-media-seek` fills it), and the bar looks for its `[controlled]` widget through shadow roots
- `<k-video>` and `<k-audio>` read the tags in the media file themselves (MP4/M4V tags, ID3v2 or ID3v1) and fill an empty `track-title`, `artist`, `album` and `year` for `kc-media-metadata`, using range requests for only the start of the file and its tag atom; values set on the element (or `k-audio-track`) win, a file without tags shows nothing, and `read-metadata="false"` turns it off. The `<k-video>` `top` slot is an overlay along the top of the video with a fading gradient (`--top-bg` replaces it) that hides with the bottom bar when the video is idle.
- Every control is `--control_height` tall (default `40px`; set it on a control, a toolbar, or any ancestor to change them all), so buttons, inputs, selects and the video/audio controls line up. Controls that are not a single row, such as `kc-audio-playlist` and `kc-audio-visualizer`, are exempt
- Two slots: the default slot is the left side, usually the icon (put text in it to always show it); `<slot name="menu-text">` is the right side, hidden except while the control is in a menu, where it shows as the text of its row. Every built-in icon-only control (`kc-bold`, `kc-undo`, `kc-media-download`, ...) renders its icon in the default slot and its label as the `menu-text` fallback, which can be replaced by slotting your own `<span slot="menu-text">`. In a menu, `kc-media-volume` becomes a mute button next to a horizontal `k-slider`, `kc-media-speed` becomes a rate selector followed by "Speed", and `kc-media-time` gets the same padding as other rows (all `Control`s have a reactive `inMenu` property for the `in-menu` attribute). A custom control should render `<slot><k-icon name="..."></k-icon></slot><slot name="menu-text">Label</slot>`
- A control is "in a menu" when it has the `in-menu` attribute, set by `kc-menu` on its controls and by `k-control-bar` on controls it moves into its "more" menu (removed when they move back). `Control` styles the shared `menu-text` slot, so non-button controls with a popup trigger (`kc-text-color`, `kc-md-image`, ...) use it too

#### ControlMenu ← Control (`controls/Menu.js`, tag `kc-menu`)

Dropdown menu trigger for grouping controls. Renders `<k-dropdown>` with a trigger button.

- Slots: `icon` for trigger icon, `label` for trigger text, default slot for menu items
- `::slotted` unifies menu item styling

#### loadControls helper (`controls/loadControls.js`)

Parses Lit `TemplateResult.strings` to find `<kc-*>` and `<k-control-group>` tags, converts tag names to PascalCase file paths, and dynamically imports them. Called by host components when `controls` attribute is set.

---

## Creating a Custom Component

```js
import ShadowComponent from 'kempo-ui/src/components/ShadowComponent.js';
import { html, css } from 'kempo-ui/src/lit-all.min.js';

class MyWidget extends ShadowComponent {
  /*
    Reactive Props / Attributes
  */
  static properties = {
    label: { type: String, reflect: true },
    active: { type: Boolean, reflect: true }
  };
  
  /*
    Lifecycle callbacks
  */
  constructor() {
    super();
    this.label = '';
    this.active = false;
  }
  
  /*
    Event Liseners
  */
  click(){
    // Do something
  }

  /*
    View
  */
  render() {
    return html`
      <button
        class="primary"
        @click=${this.click}
      >
        <strong>${this.label}</strong>
        <slot></slot>
      </button>
    `;
  }
  
  static styles = css`
    :host {
      display: block;
      border: 1px solid transparent;
    }
    :host([active]) {
      border-color: var(--c_primary);
    }
  `;

}

customElements.define('my-widget', MyWidget);
```

Key patterns:
- `static properties` declares Lit reactive properties; `reflect: true` mirrors the value to an HTML attribute
- `static styles` is a `css` tagged template; injected alongside kempo-css in shadow DOM
- `customElements.define` at the bottom of the file registers the element
- Use `this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('change', { detail: {...}, bubbles: true }))` for events
- For internal reactive state not exposed as an attribute, use `state: true` in `static properties` (reactive, not reflected): `myProp: { state: true }`
- For true non-reactive private data, use Symbol keys (`const key = Symbol();` and `this[key] = value`) — avoid `#private` fields due to poor Safari support

### propConverters

For non-standard boolean attribute patterns, import from `src/utils/propConverters.js`:

```js
import { boolExists, boolTrueFalse } from 'kempo-ui/src/utils/propConverters.js';

static properties = {
  active: { converter: boolExists, reflect: true },   // presence = true, absent = false
  enabled: { converter: boolTrueFalse, reflect: true } // attribute value is "true"/"false"
};
```

---

## kempo-css

kempo-css is injected automatically into every shadow root by `ShadowComponent`. Key CSS custom properties:

| Variable | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `--c_primary` | Primary brand color |
| `--c_secondary` | Secondary color |
| `--c_bg` | Background |
| `--c_border` | Border color |
| `--tc_primary` | Primary text color |
| `--tc_muted` | Muted text color |
| `--spacer` | Base spacing unit |
| `--spacer_h` | Half spacer |
| `--radius` | Border radius |
| `--animation_ms` | Transition duration |
| `--container_width` | Max content width |

Common utility classes (usable inside shadow DOM via kempo-css injected styles):

- Layout: `row`, `span-*`, `t-span-*`, `d-span-*`, `d-b`, `d-ib`, `d-f`, `d-if`
- Spacing: `p`, `px`, `py`, `m`, `mx`, `my`, `mb`, `mt`
- Typography: `tc-primary`, `tc-muted`, `ta-center`
- Buttons: `btn`, `btn primary`, `btn secondary`, `btn danger`, `btn ghost`
- Cards: `card`
- Badges: `badge`, `pill`

Full kempo-css docs: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dustinpoissant/kempo-css/refs/heads/main/llms.txt

---

## Utilities

Located in `src/utils/`. Import individually.

| Module | Named Exports | Description | Docs |
|--------|--------------|-------------|------|
| `debounce.js` | `default` | `debounce(fn, ms)` — delay fn until calls stop | [debounce.html](https://dustinpoissant.github.io/kempo-ui/utils/debounce.html) |
| `wait.js` | `wait`, `waitFrames` | `wait(ms)` → Promise; `waitFrames(n)` → Promise after n animation frames | [wait.html](https://dustinpoissant.github.io/kempo-ui/utils/wait.html) |
| `theme.js` | `setTheme`, `getTheme`, `subscribeToTheme`, `initTheme`, `getCalculatedTheme` | Manage light/dark/auto theme; persists to localStorage; to avoid a flash of the wrong theme on load, put `try{ document.documentElement.setAttribute('theme', localStorage.getItem('theme') \|\| 'auto'); }catch(e){}` in a blocking (non-module) script in `<head>`, such as your `init.js`, plus `<meta name="color-scheme" content="light dark">` | [theme.html](https://dustinpoissant.github.io/kempo-ui/utils/theme.html) |
| `voice.js` | `getVoice`, `setVoice`, `subscribeToVoice`, `getAvailableVoices`, `waitForVoices`, `subscribeToAvailableVoices` | Persisted speech-synthesis voice preference (mirrors `theme`); used by `<k-voice-selector>` and consumed by `<k-text-to-speech>` when no explicit `voice` attr is set | [voice.html](https://dustinpoissant.github.io/kempo-ui/utils/voice.html) |
| `conversations.js` | `saveConversation`, `getConversation`, `listConversations`, `deleteConversation`, `clearConversations`, `renameConversation`, `titleOf`, `formatConversation` | Saves whole conversations (message lists) in IndexedDB, in optional groups: `saveConversation({ id?, group?, title?, titleCustom?, debug?, messages })` (`debug` = lines of text recording what happened with the model; `formatConversation(record, {page, browser})` makes a text export of messages + that record; `renameConversation(id, title)`) → record with `id`/`createdAt`/`updatedAt`; `listConversations(group?)` newest first, without messages; rejects when IndexedDB is unavailable; used by `<k-chat persistent-id>` | [conversations.html](https://dustinpoissant.github.io/kempo-ui/utils/conversations.html) |
| `promptApi.js` | `isSupported`, `getAvailability`, `loadSystemPrompt`, `createSession` | **VERY EXPERIMENTAL, NOT USEFUL YET: in testing the browser's tiny built-in model could not answer a single question correctly; do not rely on it or show it to users.** Wraps the browser's built-in language model (Chrome Prompt API, `LanguageModel`); `createSession({ path, systemPrompt, language, temperature, topK, tools, onDownloadProgress, onLog, signal })` (`onLog(text)` gets every step as plain text) loads the system prompt from the file at `path` (or an array of files, joined in order; keep them short, the model only reads a few thousand tokens) and `tools` (`[{ name, description, inputSchema, execute(args) }]`): they are described in the system prompt and the model asks for one with a `TOOL_CALL {json}` line (a reply that is just a JSON object naming a tool, even in a code fence, counts too), which the session hides, runs, and answers with `TOOL_RESULT` (text protocol, not the browser's native tool calling, which Chrome's model ignored); `history: [{role, content}]` starts a session from earlier turns, dropping the oldest if they do not fit and returns `{ prompt(text), promptStreaming(text) (async generator of text deltas), destroy(), inputUsage, inputQuota, systemPrompt }`; used by `<k-chat prompt-api>`; tools can return data to the model (keep it short, the context is a few thousand tokens): give the model a short overview and a tool that fetches the small plain-text doc of one thing (components/<name>.txt, utils/<name>.txt, overview.txt are published for that), see utils/promptApi.html#lookup; for letting the model edit an app (e.g. a page builder) use small tools plus a `getPageOutline`-style tool rather than sending the whole JSON tree, see utils/promptApi.html#editing | [promptApi.html](https://dustinpoissant.github.io/kempo-ui/utils/promptApi.html) |
| `propConverters.js` | `boolExists`, `boolTrueFalse` | Lit property converters for boolean attributes | [propConverters.html](https://dustinpoissant.github.io/kempo-ui/utils/propConverters.html) |
| `sanitizeHtml.js` | `default`, `sanitizeHtml`, `DEFAULT_TAGS`, `DEFAULT_ATTRS_GLOBAL`, `DEFAULT_ATTRS_PER_TAG` | Whitelist HTML sanitizer; strips `<script>`, `<style>`, `<iframe>`, event-handler attrs, unsafe URL schemes; defaults sized for rich-text input. **Frontend defense only — server must also sanitize.** | [sanitizeHtml.html](https://dustinpoissant.github.io/kempo-ui/utils/sanitizeHtml.html) |
| `context.js` | `default` | `createContext(key, initialValue)` → `{ get, set, subscribe }` pub/sub state | [context.html](https://dustinpoissant.github.io/kempo-ui/utils/context.html) |
| `cookie.js` | `saveCookie`, `getCookie`, `deleteCookie` | Get/set/delete browser cookies | [cookie.html](https://dustinpoissant.github.io/kempo-ui/utils/cookie.html) |
| `drag.js` | `default` | `drag(options)` — attach mouse/touch drag listeners to an element; options: `element, threshold, ignore`, `callback`, `startCallback`, `moveCallback`, `endCallback`, `preventScroll` | [drag.html](https://dustinpoissant.github.io/kempo-ui/utils/drag.html) |
| `object.js` | `toJson`, `flattenObject`, `flattenedObjects`, `objectSummary`, `clone`, `equalObjs`, `prune`, `getAllKeys`, `getDifferencesKeys`, `diff`, `mapObject` | Object utilities | [object.html](https://dustinpoissant.github.io/kempo-ui/utils/object.html) |
| `string.js` | `camelToDash`, `dashToCamel`, `isCamelCase`, `getCase`, `escapeHTML`, `unescapeHTML`, `trim`, `compoundKey`, `toTitleCase` | String utilities | [string.html](https://dustinpoissant.github.io/kempo-ui/utils/string.html) |
| `type.js` | `typeOf`, `isType` | Type-checking helpers | [type.html](https://dustinpoissant.github.io/kempo-ui/utils/type.html) |
| `formatTimestamp.js` | `default` | Format a Date/timestamp as a human-readable string | [formatTimestamp.html](https://dustinpoissant.github.io/kempo-ui/utils/formatTimestamp.html) |
| `formatCode.js` | `default` | Beautify/format a code string | — |
| `overlayRoot.js` | `default` | `getOverlayRoot()` → the element fixed-position overlay content should mount into: `document.querySelector(window.kempo.overlayRoot)` if configured and matching, else `document.body`. Used internally by Toast, Dialog, and PhotoViewer | — |
| `renderPage.js` | `renderPage`, `createRenderer`, `collectModules`, `attributeString`, `escapeText`, `escapeAttribute` | Turns page widget nodes into HTML with no DOM (server-side rendering or the builder's preview). `renderPage(nodes, registry, { editor, sanitize })`; `editor: true` adds `data-pb-id` marks and uses each widget's `editorTag`; `collectModules(nodes, registry)` lists the module URLs a page needs | [renderPage.html](https://dustinpoissant.github.io/kempo-ui/utils/renderPage.html) |
| `pageWidth.js` | — (import for its effect) | Sets `--page-width` on the root element to the page width without the vertical scrollbar and keeps it updated (ResizeObserver); the Page Builder Fullscreen breakout and Hero breakout size from it, because `100vw` includes the scrollbar and would scroll the page sideways | [pageWidth.html](https://dustinpoissant.github.io/kempo-ui/utils/pageWidth.html) |
| `pageWidgets.js` | `widgets`, `addWidget`, `registryOf` | The widgets a page can use (`PageBuilder.widgets` is this list); `addWidget(config)` adds or replaces one and throws with a reason when the config breaks a rule; `registryOf()` gives the Map by name for `renderPage` | [pageWidgets.html](https://dustinpoissant.github.io/kempo-ui/utils/pageWidgets.html) |
| `pageTree.js` | `createNode`, `defaultNode`, `addWidget`, `insertNodes`, `removeWidgets`, `moveWidget`, `moveBy`, `moveIn`, `moveOut`, `duplicateWidgets`, `findNode`, `findSlot`, `walk`, `place`, `cloneNode`, `cloneNodes`, `freshCopies`, `valueAt`, `setValueAt`, `attributeDefault`, `sectionOpen`, `neighbour`, `sharePlace`, `isInside`, `countNodes`, `maxDepth`, `firstSlotOf`, `canContain`, `newId`, `removeNode`, `MAX_DEPTH` | Functions on a page's tree of widget nodes, shared by the page builder and a server (no DOM): add, find, move, copy and remove widgets (a section is moved from its parent's settings, never on the page); `sectionOpen(node, parent)` says whether an accordion section starts open | [pageTree.html](https://dustinpoissant.github.io/kempo-ui/utils/pageTree.html) |
| `pageFrame.js` | `default` (`PageFrame`) | The page builder's preview: an iframe with the site's stylesheets and the page drawn in editor mode (internal, the builder uses it) | [pageFrame.html](https://dustinpoissant.github.io/kempo-ui/utils/pageFrame.html) |
| `pageHistory.js` | `default` (`PageHistory`) | Undo and redo stacks of earlier and later pages, at most `limit` (50) steps, kept in memory (internal, the builder uses it) | [pageHistory.html](https://dustinpoissant.github.io/kempo-ui/utils/pageHistory.html) |
| `pageLabels.js` | `widgetIcon`, `titleOf`, `hintOf`, `sectionLabelOf` | How the page builder names a widget: its icon (`iconSrc` or `icon`, turned by `iconRotation` degrees), title, a short hint and a section's label; needs a browser (internal) | [pageLabels.html](https://dustinpoissant.github.io/kempo-ui/utils/pageLabels.html) |
| `imageSize.js` | `default` | `imageSize(src)` — Promise of `{ width, height }` of an image, or `null` when it cannot load; never rejects; needs a browser | [imageSize.html](https://dustinpoissant.github.io/kempo-ui/utils/imageSize.html) |
| `styles.js` | `styleClasses`, `styleCss`, `styleId`, `decorate`, `supportsStyles`, `shownStyles`, `cleanSides`, `STYLE_PARTS`, `SIDES`, `SIZES`, `BACKGROUNDS`, `TEXT_COLOURS`, `ALIGNS`, `CORNERS` | The styles a page builder widget has beyond its settings (kempo-css margin, padding, background, text colour, alignment, corners and borders classes, a background opacity, an id and extra classes), written the same way on the page and in the builder | [styles.html](https://dustinpoissant.github.io/kempo-ui/utils/styles.html) |
